sharedSpecification: Strict overhead orthographic Braun matte soft-touch plastic product render. Single soft overhead light; soft wide contact shadow. Centered object with generous empty margin on perfectly flat uniform #E9E6E1, no grid, texture, vignette, gradient or unrequested text. Original attached concepts are references; generated images are never used as inputs.

subjects.hub_console: Off-white tall rounded console, blank shallow grey-green LCD, orange status dot, four recessed tile icons in a 2x2 grid with PINBALL / AIR HOCKEY / CAR CRUSH / TANKS grey labels. Orange flipper with metal ball; orange mallet with graphite puck; cream sports car with orange stripes; cream tank with graphite tracks. Retry required every icon to be strictly overhead and the LCD shallow.
subjects.ah_table: Empty landscape table, width:height about 2:1, very thin rail about 1.5% of width, tiny punched air holes, thin orange vertical centre line, warm grey centre circle and goal half circles, dark left/right goal slots spanning middle 36% of playing height. No scoreboard/mallet/puck/motion. Table occupies 85% of image width. Requested 2400px or larger.
subjects.ah_mallet_orange: One orange circular base with domed centred handle; base:handle diameter ratio 2:1. Strict overhead, base occupies 65% of square width. Soft orange bounce light beneath.
subjects.ah_mallet_graphite: One graphite charcoal mallet, same circular base and centred domed handle proportions, strict overhead, base occupies 65% of square width.
subjects.ah_puck: One graphite low circular puck with slight bevel and small centred orange dot, dot diameter 18% of puck diameter. Puck occupies 60% square width. No visible side walls, motion blur or streaks.
subjects.lcd_panel: One off-white landscape Braun clock LCD module, shallow slender bezel and fine seam. Module width:height 2:1, blank grey-green screen about 80% width and 55% height, extra top bezel margin for later labels. No text, numbers, segments, branding, buttons or extra objects; module occupies 78% image width.
